---
title: "Pre-Rendering"
---

# Pre-Rendering

Pre-rendering executes Panel code at build time and embeds the static HTML output
directly into the page. When the page loads, the pre-rendered output appears
instantly. Once Pyodide finishes loading, the output transitions to a fully
interactive app.

:::{.callout-tip}
Pre-rendering is enabled globally via `pre-render: true` in `_quarto.yml` under
the `panel-live` key. Individual blocks can override with `#| pre-render: false`.
:::

## Pre-render + auto-run

Default behavior. The output appears instantly from the pre-rendered HTML.
Pyodide loads in the background and replaces the static output with the
interactive app. Best for most use cases.

```{.panel-live}
#| mode: editor
#| auto-run: true
import panel as pn
slider = pn.widgets.IntSlider(name="Value", start=0, end=100, value=42)
pn.Column(
    "**Pre-render + auto-run** — output appears instantly, becomes interactive when Pyodide loads.",
    pn.Row(slider, pn.bind(lambda v: f"### {v}", slider)),
).servable()
```

## Pre-render + no auto-run

The pre-rendered output appears instantly and stays static until the user
clicks Run. Best for documentation pages with many examples — avoids
loading Pyodide until the user explicitly requests interactivity.

```{.panel-live}
#| mode: editor
#| auto-run: false
import panel as pn
slider = pn.widgets.IntSlider(name="Brightness", start=0, end=100, value=75)
pn.Column(
    "**Pre-render + no auto-run** — static output until the user clicks Run.",
    pn.Row(slider, pn.bind(lambda v: f"### Brightness: {v}%", slider)),
).servable()
```

## Auto-run without pre-render

No build-time output. The page shows a loading state, then renders the
output once Pyodide has loaded and executed the code.

```{.panel-live}
#| mode: editor
#| pre-render: false
#| auto-run: true
import panel as pn
slider = pn.widgets.IntSlider(name="Speed", start=1, end=10, value=5)
pn.Column(
    "**No pre-render + auto-run** — loading state, then output once Pyodide is ready.",
    pn.Row(slider, pn.bind(lambda v: f"### Speed: {v}x", slider)),
).servable()
```

## No pre-render + no auto-run

No build-time output and no automatic execution. The output area is blank
until the user clicks Run. Lightest possible page load.

```{.panel-live}
#| mode: editor
#| pre-render: false
#| auto-run: false
import panel as pn
slider = pn.widgets.IntSlider(name="Volume", start=0, end=100, value=50)
pn.Column(
    "**No pre-render + no auto-run** — blank until the user clicks Run.",
    pn.Row(slider, pn.bind(lambda v: f"### Volume: {v}%", slider)),
).servable()
```
